concerns.text: T003 computes electronegativity_diff and valence_electron_diff and writes them into data/curated/filtered.csv 'conforming to specs/.../contracts/dataset.schema.yaml', but that schema has additionalProperties: false and does not list those columns. The task as written cannot pass its own schema-conformance claim — either the schema must be amended or the extra columns written elsewhere. T002's 'preserving schema' in-place write has the same latent conflict.

T002 ('Output the cleaned training set to data/curated/filtered.csv (in place...)'), T003, and T004 all overwrite data/curated/filtered.csv in place, violating constitution Principle III ('No data may be modified in place; every transformation MUST produce a new file with a documented derivation'). The tasks are not executable as constitution-compliant; each stage must write a new derived file (e.g. filtered_clean.csv, filtered_enriched.csv) with documented derivation.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T006 vs plan.md Project Structure / FR-SC Coverage Map
concerns.text: T006 consolidates training into code/models/train_models.py '(subsumes train_rf/train_gb)', but the plan's Project Structure and coverage map still specify separate train_rf.py and train_gb.py modules. An implementer following the plan builds artifacts no task verifies. Update the plan layout or the task's file naming so the two agree.

T008 says 'using the trained model's predicted activation energies' but two models are trained in T006 (RF and GB) plus a mean-predictor. The task does not name which model's predictions feed the threshold sweep, leaving the implementer to guess. Specify the model (or the selection rule).

T007 says fit Linear Regression 'from size_mismatch (plus other descriptors)' — the feature set is unspecified. Name the exact feature columns (e.g. size_mismatch, electronegativity_diff, valence_electron_diff) so the coefficient, its standard error, and the fixture test are deterministic.

T012 verifies only the ≤6 h / ≤7 GB limits (SC-004). Constitution Principle VI also mandates model training <2 CPU-hours and dataset size <10 MB; no task measures or records either, so compliance is never evidenced. Extend T012's verification (or add measurement) to log training CPU-time and curated/raw dataset sizes.

T005's verification relies on 'a schema-validation script' and T010's on 'a spot-check script', but no task creates or names these scripts (file path, invocation). Name the script files (e.g. code/validation/validate_curated.py) and which task produces them, or fold them into an existing task's deliverables.
